zh-CN.siteTitle: Codex 与 OpenAI 资讯指南：额度重置、更新与故障排查｜Codex Reset Watch
zh-CN.editorialIntro: Codex Reset Watch 是 WarpNav 维护的非官方信息站，关注 Codex 与 OpenAI 用户的实际使用问题。
zh-CN.editorialTeam: 资讯文章使用「CRW 编辑」这一组织署名，由 Codex 负责来源检索、资料整理、写作与修订，WarpNav 负责站点维护。
zh-CN.editorialMethod: 优先核对官方文档、更新日志、状态事件及相关团队的原始公开说明。区分公开事实、账号观察与编辑分析；实际测试会说明环境及验证范围。常规文章由 Codex 按编辑规则核验；如有站长逐篇人工审核，会在文章中注明。
zh-CN.editorialCorrections: 主要出处随文列出。影响结论的错误会在原文更正记录中说明，实质修订更新文章日期；故障进展沿用原事件文章。你可以通过项目仓库反馈具体段落、来源或问题。
zh-CN.seriesTimeNote: 日期按美国太平洋时间（PT）归档。统计按天去重；功能与重置可在同一天出现，储备预告计入“重置相关”。
zh-CN.seriesAwaitingVerification: 本轮尚未核实当天更新。

en.siteTitle: Codex & OpenAI Guides: Usage Resets, Updates & Troubleshooting | Codex Reset Watch
en.editorialIntro: Codex Reset Watch is an unofficial site maintained by WarpNav, focused on practical issues for Codex and OpenAI users.
en.editorialTeam: CRW editors is the organizational byline of Codex Reset Watch. Codex handles source research, synthesis, writing and revisions. WarpNav maintains the site.
en.editorialMethod: We prioritize official documentation, changelogs, status incidents and original public statements from relevant teams. Public facts, account observations and editorial analysis are distinguished. Actual tests state their environment and scope. Routine articles are checked by Codex against our editorial rules; articles personally reviewed by the site owner state that separately.
en.editorialCorrections: Articles link to their main sources. Errors affecting a conclusion are recorded on the original article, and substantive revisions update its modification date. Incident developments stay on the same event article. You can use the project repository to report a specific passage, source or issue.
en.seriesTimeNote: Dates follow US Pacific time (PT). Counts are per day; features and resets can overlap. Reset-related days include banked-reset announcements.
